interpretation: Surfaces with height variations below h look smooth to the radar. Mini-RF needs larger roughness elements than RCM to look rough, so absolute CPR values are not compared across the two radars: we compare the order of classes and the inside/outside contrast. This is an approximate calibration; no conversion factor between C- and S-band CPR is claimed. A future step is an S-band Earth reference, e.g. from NISAR.
note: inc_mean_deg = mean local incidence angle over the site box before the 30-60 deg filter (from earth_cpr.json).
